about: What the app does by itself, outside any one screen: here, getting its core back when the core process dies. Only Orbit Native has a separate core process (the Node sidecar); Electron's core runs inside the app, so these cases need the sidecar feature.

cases.title: The core process dies: Orbit relaunches itself quietly, with the same settings, and works again
cases.about: The relaunched copy starts as the orb (as after login), not with the launcher in your face, and keeps the profile's settings. Each launch has a new sign-in link, so the test signs in again.
